parsed.main_gap: Lemma 1 relies on a false unrestricted infinite sunflower claim, though the bounded-cardinality version actually needed is true and repairs the proof directly.

errors.description: Not every infinite family of distinct finite sets contains an infinite sunflower; for example, the sets {1,…,n} do not. The proposed induction can continue indefinitely. However, only sets of bounded size are needed later, and the standard bounded-size sunflower argument proves the required finiteness.
